in_hebrew.name: Patten
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Patten הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. From the Old English word 'pate' meaning 'protector' or 'defender'. This name was often given to those who held a position of responsibility or protection within their community.
